title: store_rx_floor: precheck catalog capacity before slot commit; align 512 cap with pin-table 10000
description: From 3-perspective review of bidu fix: store_rx_floor commits slot+anchor THEN records catalog; catalog failure (ENOSPC, anchor CAS, or capacity exceeded) is an indeterminate post-commit failure. At _MAX_RX_CATALOG_ENTRIES=512 a new origin fails permanently on store AND on every subsequent load (heal re-raises at dao_persistence.py:991->771-772) with no eviction path; recovery requires wiping base dir which resets ALL replay floors. Note 512 cap is inconsistent with _MAX_TRUST_ENTRIES=10000 (key_persistence.py:63) while _RX_CATALOG_MAX_SIZE formula already scales. Fix: pre-check capacity/anchor liveness before _write_to_older_slot_locked; raise/configure cap to match pin budget; document ENOSPC/anchor indeterminate window in store_rx_floor contract.
